name: Skillscout
summary: A SwiftUI Mac app and a skillscout command that list the skills of 8 coding agents, count how often chats use them, find similar ones, and ask AI for new skill ideas.

walkthrough.title: Skills are found
walkthrough.text: SkillScanner reads every SKILL.md in the agents' folders and groups the copies of each skill.

walkthrough.title: Usage is counted
walkthrough.text: PromptLibrary parses your local chats and counts the ones that loaded each skill.

walkthrough.title: You manage skills
walkthrough.text: SkillInstaller links a skill into another agent, renames and merges skills, and moves old ones to the Trash.

walkthrough.title: AI suggests skills
walkthrough.text: Analyzer turns requests you repeat into a prompt, and AIEngine asks Codex or Claude Code for ideas.

walkthrough.title: Agents use the command
walkthrough.text: The skillscout command shares the same core, so agents can list, add and merge skills too.

edges.label: browses skills
edges.note: Clicks through the window: skills by agent, by use, and similar pairs

edges.label: runs commands
edges.note: Runs skillscout in Terminal, or an agent runs it for you

edges.label: reads state
edges.note: SwiftUI views observe the @Observable store and redraw when it changes

edges.label: starts watching
edges.note: Starts one FSEvents stream for all the skills folders at launch

edges.label: scans skills
edges.note: Rescans the skills folders at launch and after each change event

edges.label: counts usage
edges.note: Parses new chat lines in the background and updates the use counts

edges.label: finds similar
edges.note: Recomputes the similar pairs in memory after each scan

edges.label: changes skills
edges.note: Adds, renames, merges or uninstalls a skill when you choose it in the window

edges.label: asks AI
edges.note: Asks for ideas, a draft or an explanation, and waits for the answer

edges.label: saves state
edges.note: Writes state.json atomically after every change you make

edges.label: checks releases
edges.note: Asks for the latest release once a day, and downloads its zip when you accept

edges.label: watches
edges.note: FSEvents on each agent's skills folder, debounced so a burst triggers one rescan

edges.label: lists skills
edges.note: skillscout list scans the folders fresh on every run

edges.label: counts usage
edges.note: skillscout usage parses the chats, reusing the app's cache when it's there

edges.label: lists pairs
edges.note: skillscout similar prints the pairs above the similarity threshold

edges.label: adds, renames, merges
edges.note: add, rename, merge and uninstall go through the same installer as the app

edges.label: suggests, explains
edges.note: skillscout suggest and explain build the same prompts as the window

edges.label: reads SKILL.md
edges.note: Reads each SKILL.md and parses its YAML frontmatter for the name and description

edges.label: compares skills
edges.note: Takes the scanned skills' text and scores every pair with TF-IDF

edges.label: parses chats
edges.note: Reads JSONL transcripts and SQLite chat databases, only what was added since the last pass

edges.label: caches parses
edges.note: Caches parsed chats, so the next launch only reads what's new

edges.label: links skills
edges.note: Links or copies the skill folder into the other agent's skills folder

edges.label: moves old copies
edges.note: Moves replaced or uninstalled skills to the Trash, never deletes them

edges.label: sends prompts
edges.note: Hands over the prompt and parses the JSON that comes back

edges.label: runs headless
edges.note: Runs codex exec or claude -p as a child process with the login shell PATH

explainers.title: How skill use is counted
explainers.summary: Where the chat counts next to every skill come from

scenes.title: Your agents keep chats
scenes.text: Cursor, Claude Code and 6 more agents save every chat on your Mac, as JSONL files and SQLite databases.

scenes.title: Each chat file is parsed once
scenes.text: PromptLibrary finds the prompts you typed and every time a chat loaded a skill, and caches them per file.

scenes.title: Uses point to skills
scenes.text: Each use names a skill folder. Old names still count, because aliases map them to the name a skill has now.

scenes.title: Sorted by use
scenes.text: The app counts the chats per skill, so the ones you never use sink to the bottom.

scenes.title: Nothing leaves your Mac
scenes.text: Counting needs no AI and no network: it's all parsing local files.

explainers.title: How a skill reaches another agent
explainers.summary: What happens when you add a skill to Claude Code

scenes.title: One skill, many agents
scenes.text: Every agent reads skills from its own folder, so a skill you wrote for Cursor is invisible to Codex.

scenes.title: You click Add
scenes.text: Pick the skill, then the agent that's missing it.

scenes.title: The Installer links it
scenes.text: Only the Installer writes to the agents' folders. It links the skill, so an edit shows up everywhere.

scenes.title: The list updates itself
scenes.text: The file watcher sees the new folder and the scanner groups it with the other copies.
